applicabilityBasis.summary: BRLA is marketed as a Brazilian-real stablecoin backed 1:1 by Brazilian fiat and used for digital transactions. It is therefore potentially within the payment-stablecoin fact pattern, although the public materials reviewed describe a Brazil-focused product rather than a U.S. GENIUS authorization pathway.

genius.notes: Avenia describes BRLA as a 1:1 BRL-backed stablecoin with monthly collateral reporting and attestations. The public materials reviewed identify a Brazil-focused issuer/correspondent context, but no U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified pathway, official application, or foreign-issuer exception registration was found as of 2026-08-14. GENIUS remains in proposed-rules phase.
